transcript:
Alice: The reports page is timing out, three endpoints take over ten seconds.
Carol: That is the missing indexes again. I will look at the slow queries this week, I can have it done by Friday.
Bob: Separate thing, the login endpoint still has no rate limiting. Someone hit it two thousand times last night.
Alice: That is urgent. Bob, can you take that one?
Bob: Yes, I will add rate limiting by Thursday.
Dave: It would be nice to have dark mode at some point.
Alice: Let's park dark mode, nobody has time this sprint.
Alice: One more thing, we agreed we will release every Thursday afternoon from now on.

Eve: The onboarding doc is out of date, the new joiner lost a day on it.
Alice: Someone needs to rewrite the setup steps, but let's decide who next week.
Eve: Agreed. Also the staging database is full, that is blocking the QA team right now.
Alice: I will clear the staging database today.

Alice: This is just a quick demo walkthrough, no decisions today.
Bob: The new dashboard looks good, the charts load fast.
Alice: Agreed, nice work. Nothing else from me.
Bob: Same here, see you tomorrow.

Carol: Checkout was down for forty minutes yesterday because the payment worker ran out of memory.
Dave: I will add a memory alert on the worker, by Monday.
Bob: We also decided to roll back automatically if error rates go above five percent.
Carol: Right, and someone should write the incident report. Dave, can you do it this week?
Dave: Sure, I will write the incident report by Friday.
Bob: Long term we might move the worker to a bigger instance, but that is not for now.

Alice: We have four candidates for the backend role.
Eve: I will send the take home task to all four today.
Alice: We decided to drop the whiteboard round, it was not telling us anything useful.
Bob: I can run the system design interviews next week.
Eve: I will also update the job description, it still mentions the old stack. Give me until Wednesday.
